description: A complete export (wire 10.2, 10.3) of alice's account, signed with the fixed service key of keys.json (service/alice) over lp("pubky-switch/v1/export-manifest", identity, body). It is the account frozen right after chain.json's last item (operations.json continues the account past that item instead). It activates under wire 10.5 at a next service enrolled with alice's current identity.json (version 3) whose trusted time is the freeze's. One chunk holds, in the order of wire 10.3: the meta part; the chain, the items of chain.json (seqs 1 to 9) and then the freeze transition (seq 10, wire 6.5) for documents.json's freeze, with the record.put of seq 6 as a stub only, since seq 8 supersedes it (wire 7.5); an app part for each app the identity.json lists: the wallet with its record and receive key of seqs 3 and 4 and its cursor at 9, the phone revoked at seq 9, and the executor, the phone and the executor having registered nowhere in this chain; the live claim of seq 7, its creator the wallet, then its one entry as a claim_entry part with that entry's transition proof, which the claim is replayed from, and cert null, since the wallet's app part carries the certificate the entry was checked against; the shared record at (1, 8), its op and cert null since the chain part at seq 8 and the wallet's app part carry them, and its proof the transition proof of that write (chain.json, seq 8), which O keeps with the record; and a batch part for each of the three batches the stubs name, with its operation hash and time and no proofs. The inbox entry at seq 5 (bob's assignment) isn't exported: the wallet, its one target, moved its cursor past it, so O deleted it. The head is the freeze transition, and last_time is its time, after the freeze's issued_at (wire 10.5). The meta part's app_added_at maps each app reachable at the freeze (current, with a receive key) to the apps_version at which it became reachable: the wallet alone, at 1, since the phone is revoked and neither it nor the executor holds a receive key; apps_version is 4, as http.json's append names it. The manifest names the freeze by its hash; its chunk entry gives the chunk's length and BLAKE3 hash. record_rejections are the chunk's record part as a faulty O could send it instead, each refused at the activation (409): without its proof, with a signature that doesn't verify with O's key (another proof's), and with the proof of another write; the chunk with such a part also has another hash, which a check of the part alone needn't recompute. claim_rejections are the chunk's claim part as a faulty O could send it, each refused at the activation for its rule (409 unless status says otherwise): with the phone as its creator; with a last_entry_ms 1 ms before its entry's time; with the open attempt shown failed and the entry's proof (entry_proof) signed again by O to show that state, which the replay of the entry refuses; and with the attempt failed by a further claim_entry part (claim_entry, inserted after the claim's own entry) whose operation O signed with its service key in place of the wallet's signing key, refused at that entry's first check (401).
